# bitbucket_project (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Bitbucket Cloud project by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_project" "platform" {
  key = "PLAT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/key".
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the project is private.
- `name` (String) Project display name.
